title: Principality of Peremyshl
capsule: The Principality of Peremyshl was one of the Rus' principalities centred on the city of Peremyshl (modern Przemyśl, Poland) in the Carpathian foothills of Red Ruthenia. It emerged as a distinct appanage in the mid-eleventh century when Yaroslav the Wise's sons divided Kievan Rus', with Rurik Rostislavich and his descendants holding it through the late eleventh and twelfth centuries. The principality occupied a strategically contested zone between Poland and Hungary, and its rulers frequently sought outside backing to maintain autonomy. By the mid-twelfth century it was absorbed into the growing Principality of Galicia under Yaroslav Osmomysl (r. 1153–1187).
